name: 2025 Summer Riverine Flooding Event
location: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Western Punjab, Upper Sindh (Districts: Kashmore, Ghotki, Sukkur, Shikarpur, Khairpur, Dadu, Naushero Feroz, Jamshoro, Larkana, Shaheed Benazirabad)
impact: Widespread inundation affecting 2.2 million people, high flows in Indus River (500,000 cusecs at Sukkur), activated hill torrents, and Tarbela Dam at max capacity.
context: Driven by La Niña, positive IOD, high Tibetan Plateau temperatures, and active Western Disturbances coinciding with monsoon trough. Heavy rains in upper catchments and glacial melt lead to critical river flows and localized cloud bursts.
